case: PostgreSQL numeric[] exact text in XML, HTML, and Markdown exports
contract: The numeric[] contains a 40-digit integer, a 30-digit fractional value, a scale-preserving 1.2300, NaN, positive and negative Infinity, and SQL NULL.
PostgreSQL native type, array text, array_to_json, and array_send oracles are checked; rebinding matches native JSON and wire bytes.
XML and HTML output preserve the complete array text with XML entities decoded by their format rules; Markdown output preserves its JSON-quoted array text with escaped backslashes.
Existing JSON, CSV, XLSX string-cell, and SQL replay checks continue to run in the same contract.
